styles = zin.read('xl/styles.xml').decode('utf-8')

root = ET.fromstring(sheet)

for c in root.findall('.//m:c', NS):
    ref = c.get('r')
    v = c.find('m:v', NS)
    if v is not None and v.text is not None and v.text.strip() != '':
        try:
            vals[ref] = float(v.text)
        except ValueError:
            pass

def fmt(x):
    return str(int(x)) if float(x).is_integer() else repr(float(x))

data = []

    C, D, F = vals[f'C{r}'], vals[f'D{r}'], vals[f'F{r}']

    G = E - C * F
    data.append((r, E, G, G / E))

sumC = sum(vals[f'C{r}'] for r in range(2, 10))
sumE = sum(d[1] for d in data)
sumG = sum(d[2] for d in data)
total_margin = sumG / sumE

def rep(text, old, new, label):
    n = text.count(old)
    assert n == 1, f'{label}: expected 1 match, found {n}'
    return text.replace(old, new)

            '<c r="H1" s="1" t="inlineStr"><is><t>Profit Margin %</t></is></c></row>', 'H1')

for r, E, G, margin in data:
    e_str, g_str, m_str = fmt(E), fmt(G), fmt(margin)
    sheet = rep(sheet, f'<c r="E{r}"><f>C{r}*D{r}</f><v></v></c>',
                f'<c r="E{r}"><f>C{r}*D{r}</f><v>{e_str}</v></c>', f'E{r}')

                f'<c r="G{r}"><f>E{r}-C{r}*F{r}</f><v>{g_str}</v></c>'
                f'<c r="H{r}" s="3"><f>G{r}/E{r}</f><v>{m_str}</v></c></row>', f'H{r}')

sheet = rep(sheet, '<c r="C10"><f>SUM(C2:C9)</f><v></v></c>',
            f'<c r="C10"><f>SUM(C2:C9)</f><v>{fmt(sumC)}</v></c>', 'C10')
sheet = rep(sheet, '<c r="E10"><f>SUM(E2:E9)</f><v></v></c>',
            f'<c r="E10"><f>SUM(E2:E9)</f><v>{fmt(sumE)}</v></c>', 'E10')
sheet = rep(sheet, '<c r="G10"><f>SUM(G2:G9)</f><v></v></c></row>',
            f'<c r="G10"><f>SUM(G2:G9)</f><v>{fmt(sumG)}</v></c>'
            f'<c r="H10" s="3"><f>G10/E10</f><v>{fmt(total_margin)}</v></c></row>', 'H10')

styles = rep(styles, '<numFmts count="0"/>',
             '<numFmts count="1"><numFmt numFmtId="164" formatCode="0.0%"/></numFmts>', 'numFmts')
styles = rep(styles, '<cellXfs count="3">', '<cellXfs count="4">', 'cellXfs count')

             '<xf numFmtId="164" fontId="0" fillId="0" borderId="0" pivotButton="0" quotePrefix="0" xfId="0"/></cellXfs>',
             'new xf')

zout = zipfile.ZipFile(TMP, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED)

    if item.filename == 'xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml':
        payload = sheet.encode('utf-8')
    elif item.filename == 'xl/styles.xml':
        payload = styles.encode('utf-8')
